Jordan Hale: Heads-up — EmberTech asked for a one-off onboarding: 6-month prepaid $40,000 credits, 15% reseller discount first 3 months, 10% rev-share on net. They request net-30 invoicing and monthly payouts. Need finance + legal sign-off. cc @Priya Sen @Marcus Lee

Priya Sen: Quick Qs — payment method? Do we recognize monthly? What's COGS?

Jordan Hale: They'll wire via ACH. Recognition: defer $40k -> recognize monthly over 6 months. Infra run-rate from Marcus ~ $7k COGS for the period.

Marcus Lee: Confirmed COGS ~ $7k (hosted). No PS expected. Rev-share on net after platform fees OK.

Rana Singh: Legal: add addendum to reseller agreement capturing rev-share calc, tax withholding, KYC, and promo window. I'll draft once you confirm reserve policy.

Priya Sen: Treasury: exposure ok < $50k. Recommend reserve 20% of prepaid into GL 5400 (reseller_reserve) until monthly reconciliations. Approve 15% discount (3 months), net-30, monthly payouts, rev-share reserve 20% pending KYC and wire proof. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Hale: Awesome. billing-bot please open ticket and tag plan 'ember-prepaid-v1', attach SOW and wire confirmation when I upload.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5234: "EmberTech prepaid + reseller promo" — tasks: create plan_id 'ember-prepaid-v1', invoice template, GL 5400 mapping. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-5234

Rana Singh: I'll review addendum draft today. Jordan pls attach SOW to BILL-5234 and loop Partnerships for final sign-off.

Jordan Hale: On it, thanks all! :rocket:
